A RELAXING STAY AT COLUMBUS AIRPORT

Find us at John Glenn Columbus International Airport – our free shuttle will get you to/from the hotel. We're seven miles from Downtown Columbus, and 15 minutes from the Ohio State University. Easton Town Center and the Franklin Park Conservatory and Botanical Gardens are within 10 minutes. Enjoy our outdoor pool, free hot breakfast, and free WiFi.
